description:
World records are measured in numbers, but they are built with passion.

The YANGWANG U9X reaching 496.22 km/h is already history, yet the real story lives in the people who made it possible. In the engineers who questioned every assumption and redefined the limits of technology. In the developers who created a tire capable of holding the road when physics said it shouldn’t. In the driver who became the voice, the heart, and the courage of the entire team the moment he pressed the accelerator.

This film takes you behind the numbers. It shows the faces, the voices, and the emotions of those who poured their talent and pride into a single, extraordinary goal. It is not a marketing story, but a human one. A story about belief, resilience, and the relentless pursuit of progress.

At BYD, we do not simply aim to break records. We aim to open new paths, to set new benchmarks, and to prove that with vision and determination, the future has no limits.

This film is our tribute to the people who turned ambition into achievement and made history on the track.

TOP SPEED RECORD DRIVER - MARC BASSENG
DOCUMENTARY PRODUCTION - www.youtube.com/@FALK-STUDIO
HOST & NARRATOR - PAUL REES, RACING DRIVER

#YANGWANG #U9XTreme #BYD #BuildYourDreams #ThePursuitBeyond
